findings.issue: Security note, theoretical only. BatchFileReader.read(path) takes an arbitrary absolute path string straight out of the history_entry row with no confinement to ~/.rectify/history. The paths are app-written, the bytes only feed a PNG decode and an XML parse, and the follow-up envelope carries the FRESH dump (verifyAfterHierarchy) rather than the stored XML, so there is no exfiltration path from a tampered row. No new network surface, no secret, and the reader never throws.
